package.description: Uploads game builds to Steam with Valve's steamcmd.

en-GB.description: Uploads game builds to Steam with Valve's steamcmd.
en-GB.longDescription: steamship runs Valve's own steamcmd with your app_build and depot_build scripts, sets steamcmd up pinned and verified, checks the scripts before anything is sent, reports the BuildID or the reason an upload failed, and never keeps a password.
en-GB.name: steamship
